verdict.rationale: Drata publishes an llms.txt on its help center (help.drata.com/llms.txt), and its content mirrors help articles an agent could ingest. However, probes show the developer/API docs site has no llms.txt (404), no markdown variants (404), and no OpenAPI spec at the probed paths. Agent-oriented coverage is therefore limited to help-center content. Missing for 10: llms.txt or markdown for the developer/API docs, a fetchable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can use the help-center llms.txt effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
